AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.status_name)), '') NOT IN (N'停用', N'作废', N'下架', N'无效') ) AS totalSku, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales > 0 THEN product_no ELSE NULL END) AS INT) AS activeSku FROM fact_sales_day

WITH daily_stock AS ( SELECT stock_date, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(stock_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS dayStockSaleMoney FROM fact_stock_day WHERE stock_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND stock_date <= #{param.periodEnd}
GROUP BY stock_date ) SELECT ISNULL(AVG(CAST(dayStockSaleMoney AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) FROM daily_stock

SELECT sale_date AS saleDate, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalGross FROM fact_sales_day
GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC

SELECT sale_date AS pointDate, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_quantity AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSaleQuantity, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalGross, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_cost AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSaleCost FROM fact_sales_day
GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC

GROUP BY CAST(xsdate AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(xsdate AS DATE) ASC

SELECT stock_date AS pointDate, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(stock_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalStockCost FROM fact_stock_day WHERE stock_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND stock_date <= #{param.periodEnd}

two_class_no, two_class_name three_class_no, three_class_name four_class_no, four_class_name five_class_no, five_class_name

SELECT sale_date AS pointDate, sale_channel AS saleChannel, CASE WHEN sale_channel = 1 THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(online_type)), '') END AS onlineType, MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(online_name)), '')) AS onlineName, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSales FROM fact_sales_day WHERE sale_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND sale_date <= #{param.periodEnd}
GROUP BY sale_date, sale_channel, CASE WHEN sale_channel = 1 THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(online_type)), '') END ORDER BY pointDate ASC, saleChannel ASC, onlineType ASC

WITH base_data AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN v.gender IN (1, 2) THEN v.gender ELSE 3 END AS gender, CASE WHEN v.birthday IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, v.birthday, #{referenceDate}) - CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(#{referenceDate}), MONTH(v.birthday), DAY(v.birthday)) > #{referenceDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN v.age IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(v.age AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS ageValue, sh7_saleplu.sale_no AS saleNo, CAST(sh7_saleplu.act_money AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS actMoney, CAST(sh7_saleplu.sale_quantity AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS saleQuantity FROM sh7_saleplu LEFT JOIN vip_base_info v ON v.card_no = sh7_saleplu.card_no WHERE CAST(sh7_saleplu.xsdate AS DATE) >= #{param.periodStart} AND CAST(sh7_saleplu.xsdate AS DATE) <= #{param.periodEnd}
) SELECT gender, ageValue, ISNULL(SUM(actMoney), 0) AS totalSales, ISNULL(SUM(saleQuantity), 0) AS totalSaleQuantity, ISNULL(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT saleNo) AS DECIMAL(20, 2)), 0) AS totalCustomerCount FROM base_data GROUP BY gender, ageValue ORDER BY gender ASC, ageValue ASC

SELECT product_no AS productNo, MAX(product_barcode) AS productBarcode, MAX(product_name) AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales > 0 THEN store_no ELSE NULL END) AS storeNum, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_quantity AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS saleQuantity, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS sales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS gross, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_cost AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS saleCost, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(cx_flag)), '0') IN ('1', 'Y', 'y', 'true', 'TRUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS promotionFlag, MIN(sale_date) AS firstSaleDate FROM fact_sales_day WHERE sale_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND sale_date <= #{param.periodEnd}
GROUP BY product_no

SELECT product_no AS productNo, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(stock_quantity AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS stockQuantity, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(stock_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS stockSaleMoney FROM fact_stock_day WHERE stock_date = #{stockDate}
GROUP BY product_no

one_class_no AS classNo, one_class_name AS className, 1 AS classLevel

three_class_no AS classNo, three_class_name AS className, 3 AS classLevel

one_class_no AS classNo, one_class_name AS className, 1 AS classLevel
, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS classSales FROM fact_sales_day WHERE sale_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND sale_date <= #{param.periodEnd}
GROUP BY product_no,
one_class_no, one_class_name
two_class_no, two_class_name
three_class_no, three_class_name
four_class_no, four_class_name
one_class_no, one_class_name
), sales_class_rank AS ( SELECT productNo, classNo, className, classLevel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY productNo ORDER BY classSales DESC, classNo ASC) AS rn FROM sales_class_base WHERE classNo IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(classNo)) <> '' ), product_meta_rank AS ( SELECT p.*, s.classNo AS salesClassNo, s.className AS salesClassName, s.classLevel AS salesClassLevel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.product_no ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.productNo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.store_no ASC ) AS rn FROM base_dept_products p LEFT JOIN sales_class_rank s ON s.productNo = p.product_no AND s.rn = 1 WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.product_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_no)) <> '' AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.status_name)), '') NOT IN (N'停用', N'作废', N'下架', N'无效') ) SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.product_barcode AS productBarcode, p.product_name AS productName, p.status_name AS productStatus, CAST(ISNULL(p.status_no, 0) AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS productStatusNo, p.product_brand AS brandName, p.product_spec AS spec, ISNULL(CAST(p.product_taxin_inprice AS DECIMAL(20, 6)), 0) AS inPrice, ISNULL(CAST(p.product_saleprice AS DECIMAL(20, 6)), 0) AS salesPrice, p.seasonable_flag AS seasonableFlag, CASE WHEN ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.seasonable_flag)), '0') IN ('1', 'Y', 'y', 'true', 'TRUE') THEN N'是' ELSE N'否' END AS seasonableFlagName, CAST(p.seasonable_start_date AS DATE) AS seasonableStartDate, CAST(p.seasonable_end_date AS DATE) AS seasonableEndDate, CAST(p.first_order_date AS DATE) AS firstSaleDate,
COALESCE(p.salesClassNo, p.one_class_no) AS classNo, COALESCE(p.salesClassName, p.one_class_name) AS className, COALESCE(p.salesClassLevel, 1) AS classLevel
COALESCE(p.salesClassNo, p.two_class_no) AS classNo, COALESCE(p.salesClassName, p.two_class_name) AS className, COALESCE(p.salesClassLevel, 2) AS classLevel
COALESCE(p.salesClassNo, p.three_class_no) AS classNo, COALESCE(p.salesClassName, p.three_class_name) AS className, COALESCE(p.salesClassLevel, 3) AS classLevel
COALESCE(p.salesClassNo, p.four_class_no) AS classNo, COALESCE(p.salesClassName, p.four_class_name) AS className, COALESCE(p.salesClassLevel, 4) AS classLevel
COALESCE(p.salesClassNo, p.one_class_no) AS classNo, COALESCE(p.salesClassName, p.one_class_name) AS className, COALESCE(p.salesClassLevel, 1) AS classLevel
FROM product_meta_rank p WHERE p.rn = 1

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, MAX(v.vendor_no) AS productVendorNo, MAX(v.vendor_name) AS productVendorName, CONCAT(MAX(v.vendor_no), MAX(v.vendor_name)) AS productVendorNoName FROM base_dept_products p LEFT JOIN base_vendor_product_info v ON v.product_no = p.product_no WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY p.product_no

WITH brand_dim AS ( SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), '')) AS productBrand FROM base_dept_products p WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY p.product_no ), sales_base AS ( SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.productBrand)), ''), N'/') AS brandNo, MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.productBrand)), '')) AS productBrand, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales > 0 THEN fact_sales_day.product_no ELSE NULL END) AS skuCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales > 0 THEN fact_sales_day.store_no ELSE NULL END) AS activeStoreCount, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_quantity AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS saleQuantity, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS sales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS gross, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sale_cost AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS saleCost, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(cx_flag)), '0') IN ('1', 'Y', 'y', 'true', 'TRUE') THEN fact_sales_day.product_no ELSE NULL END) AS activitySku FROM fact_sales_day LEFT JOIN brand_dim d ON d.productNo = fact_sales_day.product_no WHERE sale_date >= #{param.periodStart} AND sale_date <= #{param.periodEnd}
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.productBrand)), ''), N'/') ), brand_meta AS ( SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') AS brandNo, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN N'/' ELSE N'1' END AS brandType, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN N'无品牌' ELSE N'其他品牌' END AS brandTypeName FROM base_dept_products p WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') ) SELECT s.brandNo, ISNULL(s.productBrand, CASE WHEN s.brandNo = N'/' THEN N'无品牌' ELSE s.brandNo END) AS productBrand, ISNULL(m.brandType, CASE WHEN s.brandNo = N'/' THEN N'/' ELSE N'1' END) AS brandType, ISNULL(m.brandTypeName, CASE WHEN s.brandNo = N'/' THEN N'无品牌' ELSE N'其他品牌' END) AS brandTypeName, CAST(ISNULL(s.skuCount, 0) AS INT) AS skuCount, CAST(ISNULL(s.activeStoreCount, 0) AS INT) AS activeStoreCount, ISNULL(s.saleQuantity, 0) AS saleQuantity, ISNULL(s.sales, 0) AS sales, ISNULL(s.gross, 0) AS gross, ISNULL(s.saleCost, 0) AS saleCost, CAST(ISNULL(s.activitySku, 0) AS INT) AS activitySku FROM sales_base s LEFT JOIN brand_meta m ON m.brandNo = s.brandNo ORDER BY s.sales DESC, s.brandNo ASC

SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') AS brandNo, MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), '')) AS productBrand, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN N'/' ELSE N'1' END AS brandType, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN N'无品牌' ELSE N'其他品牌' END AS brandTypeName, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ownBrandNo, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS ownBrandName, MIN(CAST(p.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS firstSaleDate FROM base_dept_products p WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_brand)), ''), N'/')

SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_spec)), ''), N'/') AS specNo, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_spec)), ''), N'/') AS specName, CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_spec)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN N'/' ELSE N'1' END AS specType, CASE WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_spec)), ''), N'/') = N'/' THEN N'无规格' ELSE N'其他规格' END AS specTypeName, MIN(CAST(p.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS firstSaleDate FROM base_dept_products p WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.product_spec)), ''), N'/')

WITH product_scope AS ( SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, MIN(CAST(p.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS firstSaleDate FROM base_dept_products p WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY p.product_no ), tag_meta AS ( SELECT t.tag_type_no AS tagType, MAX(t.tag_type_name) AS tagTypeName, t.tag_no AS tagNo, MAX(t.tag_name) AS tagName, CONCAT(t.tag_type_no, N'|', t.tag_no) AS metricKey, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS isUntagged, MIN(p.firstSaleDate) AS firstSaleDate FROM product_tag_info t INNER JOIN product_scope p ON p.productNo = t.product_no GROUP BY t.tag_type_no, t.tag_no ), untagged_meta AS ( SELECT N'*' AS tagType, N'无标签' AS tagTypeName, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tagNo, N'无标签' AS tagName, N'__UNTAGGED__' AS metricKey, CAST(1 AS BIT) AS isUntagged, MIN(p.firstSaleDate) AS firstSaleDate FROM product_scope p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_tag_info t WHERE t.product_no = p.productNo ) ) SELECT tagType, tagTypeName, tagNo, tagName, metricKey, isUntagged, firstSaleDate FROM ( SELECT * FROM tag_meta UNION ALL SELECT * FROM untagged_meta ) x
